items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yes. I did. Yeah. And uh, and uh it was uh, at the last minute as I was walkin' – of course we rehearsed, but at rehearsal I was gettin' lost, you know, uh, my uh, my chords were overshadowed by the orchestra. So I said, "What can I do?" I mean I was in an unconscious dilemma and then on the way to the piano at the performance, after I made my little speech, I had to go back to Ellington. You play it way up high in octaves and it cut right through. So I was very proud of that decision, a last minute uh decision.…
